messages:
Zara: quick snapshot of Tapir-12b quant sweep across summary-lens and reranker slices. topline: int8 ~ -0.9 ROUGE-L vs fp16, int6 ~ -2.6; cost per 1k tok: fp16 $0.0256, int8 $0.0190, int6 $0.0138 (~46% off fp16). p95 latency delta: int8 +5ms, int6 +11ms.
Nate: which slices? n?
Zara: summary-lens n=900, reranker n=1.2k. rerank MRR@10: fp16 0.768, int8 0.761 (-0.9%), int6 0.747 (-2.7%). per-slice: multi-doc summaries and noisy user transcripts drive most int6 loss.
Faye: product constraint: core search requires <1% MRR loss. So int6 can't be default for that.
Zara: my rec: default->int8 for user-facing; route int6 to batch/archive and low-priority endpoints. Keep 4% fp16 holdback. Add 1% int6 canary for 72h on synthetic traffic to monitor regressions.
Nate: routing snippet please
Zara: ```
routes:
  - match: {endpoint:'/api/summarize', priority:'critical'}
    model: tapir-12b-fp16
  - match: {endpoint:'/api/summarize', priority:'normal'}
    model: tapir-12b-int8
  - match: {endpoint:'/api/export'}
    model: tapir-12b-int6
  - holdback: 4% -> tapir-12b-fp16
  - canary: 1% -> tapir-12b-int6 (72h)
```
li: ops: can infra estimate daily savings if 20% of traffic moves to int8? rough calc pls.
ops-bot: quick calc: if GTN ~10M tokens/day, 20% -> 2M tokens. savings = 2M*(0.0256-0.0190)/1000 ≈ $13.2/day. If instead 15% moves to int6, added savings ≈ 10M*15%*(0.0190-0.0138)/1000 ≈ $7.8/day.
Faye: scorecard for PMs: bullets: cost down int8 ~26% vs fp16, int6 ~46%; fidelity drop int8 ~0.9 ROUGE-L / 0.9% MRR, int6 ~2.6 ROUGE-L / 2.7% MRR; latency p95 up int8 +5ms, int6 +11ms; rec: int8 default, int6 only offline/canary, 4% fp16 holdback.
Zara: I'll push eval charts, add per-slice alerts at >1.0 ROUGE-L or >1.2% MRR and create INF ticket for canary monitoring.
ops-bot: ticket INF-2255 created (owner: li)
